_comment: Single source of truth for interpreting Weibo's verified* user fields. Both blacklist_deep and top_followed read from this one file (via weibo_tool/verified_config.py); edit here instead of hard-coding in code. The verified_type/ext/level mappings are Weibo-version dependent and partly heuristic — update the lists as Weibo changes them; codes that are not listed resolve to the unknown_label instead of being mislabelled.

verified_type._comment: Coarse verified-type -> label. Rules applied by verified_type_label(): (1) not verified -> unverified_label; (2) verified but type is null -> unclassified_label; (3) type in 'personal' -> 'personal_v'; (4) type > 0 -> 'org_v'; (5) type < 0 -> 'daren'.

verified_type_ext._comment: Heuristic subtype codebook for verified_type_ext. NOTE: ext meaning differs by context (org vs personal), so this is primarily meaningful for ORG (verified_type > 0) accounts; personal accounts' ext encodes a different field/category scheme. Values shift with Weibo versions. Edit as needed; unknown codes resolve to unknown_label.

verified_level._comment: Personal verification tier (黄V / 橙V / 金V). Working hypothesis: 1=huang_v, 2=cheng_v, 3=jin_v, 0=none. Weibo recomputes this dynamically (~every 30 days) from read-count / follower-engagement (heat); confirm against a known account before relying on it.

exclusions._comment: Name-based lists for stripping official / state-media accounts from the top-followed ranking. Mirrors the old config/account_categories.json.

exact: 微博创作者广告共享计划

profile_visit._comment: profile-visit only visits PERSONAL accounts; organization (blue-V) accounts - enterprise / official / government / media / other org (verified_type > 0) - are skipped before any request is sent. Set skip_organization:false to visit everyone. Overridable at runtime with --include-org.
